briefings.title: 250 Years of American Capitalism: Hamilton, the GFC, & the AI Boom | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 71
briefings.tldr: In a sweeping retrospective on 250 years of U.S. economic history, Steve Eisman and co-author Adrian Wooldridge analyze how American capitalism evolved from the Hamilton-Jefferson debate through the Industrial Revolution, Great Depression, and Great Financial Crisis, driven by a unique national culture of entrepreneurial ambition and corporate innovation.
